vehicles.trans: 6-speed Tiptronic or 7-speed S-tronic DSG (varies by year)
vehicles.slot: 8P (2006-2013): Tiptronic/S-tronic. Pop out ashtray insert, remove cap underneath, depress button with allen key. 8V (2013-2020) / 8Y (2021+): RED TOOL from spare wheel kit in trunk: RED TOOL from spare wheel kit in trunk — cupholder procedure.
shift: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — strongly preferred for all variants.
Under-hood jump terminal: + on firewall (red cover), − to chassis ground.
Once powered, press brake and select N.
8P (2006-2013) Tiptronic WITHOUT POWER — ASHTRAY RELEASE:
Remove the ASHTRAY/COIN TRAY in FRONT of the gear selector (NOT next to it).
Press the release tab to pop the ashtray insert out.
Under the ashtray mount, remove the small cap. Insert allen key or flathead and depress button firmly.
While holding button, press brake and move selector to N.
8V (2013-2020) / 8Y (2021+) WITHOUT POWER — RED TOOL:
Open trunk, lift spare wheel cover, retrieve RED TOOL from spare wheel kit.
Pull up rubber insert in FRONT cupholder. Remove plastic cap using key blade or flathead.
Insert red tool, rotate CLOCKWISE to release park lock. Keep tool VERTICAL while moved.
S-tronic/DSG on ANY variant: REQUIRES 12V power — no mechanical override.
neutral: Apply parking brake.
BATTERY LOCATION VARIES: 8P (2006-2013): trunk passenger side. 8V/8Y: under rear seat or trunk depending on trim.
Use under-hood jump terminal — + on firewall (red cover), − to chassis ground.
Use AGM-compatible jump pack.
Once powered, press brake and select N.
If power cannot be restored: 8V/8Y use red tool procedure above. 8P use shift lock slot.
S-tronic/DSG: power REQUIRED — cannot shift DSG without 12V.
Quattro AWD variants: FLATBED PREFERRED.
vehicles.notes: Battery location varies: often under rear seat. A3 8P (2006-2013), 8V (2014-2020), 8Y (2021+). DSG/S-tronic REQUIRES 12V power to shift — electro-hydraulic clutch packs will not release without power. Always restore battery before attempting any shift.
vehicles.warn: S-tronic DSG: NEVER tow with wheels on ground. Flatbed only.
vehicles.towMethod: FWD: lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air. Quattro AWD: flatbed only. AWD without flatbed: wheel-lift with dollies on opposite axle. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
towNotes: FWD: lift from front (front/drive wheels in the air) freely. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.

knownIssues.title: DSG/S-tronic Requires Power to Shift
knownIssues.detail: S-tronic dual-clutch transmission requires 12V power to shift to neutral. Battery is often located under the rear seat — not under the hood. Jump the 12V battery first, then shift.

knownIssues.title: Battery Not Under Hood
knownIssues.detail: Battery location varies by generation — frequently under the rear seat or in the trunk. Do not waste time looking under the hood first.

knownIssues.title: Park Lock Release: Red Tool in Spare Wheel Kit
knownIssues.detail: Many Audi models (approximately 2014+) include a red emergency park lock release tool stored in the spare wheel kit in the trunk. Without power, open the trunk, lift the spare wheel cover, and retrieve this tool. Remove the rubber insert from the FRONT cupholder, remove the plastic cap inside, insert the red tool and rotate CLOCKWISE to release the park lock. Keep the red tool VERTICAL while the vehicle is being moved — removing it re-engages Park. Older Audi models use a traditional shift lock slot near the gear selector base.

battery.location: Under rear seat (most) or trunk — varies by generation
battery.jumpTerminals: Under hood: red fused jump terminal near firewall, black ground bolt on strut tower
battery.warnings: Never jump directly at battery — use hood terminals only. AGM battery requires AGM-compatible charger.
